name: Mapa de Coherencia Temporal
algorithm: Temporal Coherence Map — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method creates temporal coherence maps for deepfake detection:

1. **Feature Seguimiento Across Frames**: Dense feature correspondences are established between consecutive frames using optical flow, and long-range correspondences across multiple frames using feature matching. This creates a spatio-temporal feature trajectory map.

2. **Local Coherencia Cálculo**: For each pixel, temporal coherence is computed as the consistency of its feature trajectory — smooth, physically plausible trajectories have high coherence, while erratic or discontinuous trajectories have low coherence. The coherence map reveals regions with temporal instability.

3. **Coherencia Map Espacial Análisis**: Natural video shows uniformly high coherence for static regions and physically motivated coherence patterns for moving objects. The method analyzes the coherence map for anomalous low-coherence regions — deepfake-generated areas often show reduced temporal coherence, particularly at face boundaries and in texture regions.

4. **Rostro - Background Coherencia Comparación**: The average coherence in face regions vs. background provides a diagnostic ratio. In authentic video, both show similar coherence levels. Deepfakes typically show lower coherence in the generated face (per-frame independent generation) compared to the naturally captured background.

5. **Coherencia Temporal Trends**: The per-frame average coherence is tracked over time. Natural video maintains high, stable coherence. Deepfake videos may show coherence drops correlated with challenging face poses, expressions, or lighting conditions where the generator produces more temporally inconsistent output.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante temporal coherence map analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow based CNN. ICCV Workshop.
